domains.actor: Every actor owns a distinct logical heap or arena and an incarnation-scoped identity. No direct mutable graph aliases across actors.
domains.tenant: One tenant VM/protection domain contains multiple actor arenas. A tenant security boundary requires enforced memory isolation, host-import restrictions, quotas, and independent termination; a mere arena is insufficient.
domains.host: A trusted host mediates and authorizes tenant creation, capability delegation, cross-tenant messaging and teardown.

ownership.exclusive_mutable: A mutable graph has at most one usable actor owner; failed send admission preserves sender ownership.
ownership.immutable: Deeply immutable reachable graphs may be safely shared within a tenant after mutable aliases are invalidated.
ownership.borrow: Active read loans prevent writes, transfer, mutation or reclamation until released.
ownership.same_tenant_move: Transfer by ownership-version change, with no required payload copy if runtime backing allows it.
ownership.cross_tenant: Raw handles and pointers denied. Values cross via broker-authorized serialization/copy into the destination tenant domain.

identity: All handles bind to trusted root, tenant generation, actor incarnation, object version and unforgeable host-side authority; ID strings alone are not authorization.
capabilities: All resource rights default denied. Host-granted tenant-scoped rights may be attenuated and revoked. Revoke before reuse and revalidate at privileged operations.
lifecycle: Close mailbox to new admissions, fence work, revoke or drain outstanding loans, then reclaim actor/tenant allocation domains; no dangling cross-tenant references.
scheduling: Bound tenant CPU, heap, actor count, mailbox and I/O budgets. Host must be able to terminate non-cooperating untrusted tenants without terminating neighbor tenants.
security: A source-free reference model is not a memory sandbox. Untrusted guest execution requires actual validated Wasm/Graal isolate or other proven boundary; backend MUST fail closed if unavailable.
evidenceRule: A test of the reference model cannot be reported as compiled guest execution, memory sandbox validation, or cross-backend parity.
